# Theme 05 — DNA Unzip

**Working titles:** Helix Works · Base Pair Cascade · Unzip

**Role:** Metaphor skin only.

---

## Fantasy

Packets look like short DNA strands. Shared bases “pair and unzip.”
A merge looks like recombination; a scalar looks like an excised fragment;
a residual is the longer recombinant strand.

---

## Mapping (metaphorical)

| Algebra | DNA look |
|---------|----------|
| Symbols | Bases / beads |
| Seam | Complementary pair region |
| Sandhi | Recombine |
| Vichcheda | Unzip / cut |
| Scalar | Excised fragment energy |
| Zero | Lethal mismatch |

---

## Strengths

- Instant visual recognition.
- Easy match / unzip animations.
- Attractive to biology-curious players.

## Weaknesses

- **Not** the scientific home of the rewrite.
- Risk of false claims (“quantum DNA game”).
- Nested Capelli determinants do not map cleanly to real genetics.

---

## Commercial rule

Use only as a **cosmetic skin** or early prototype art test.
Never use as the primary scientific claim in marketing copy.

---

## Decision notes

Reject as flagship theme. Optional palette swap later.
